title: assure.NotPassedAt
description: Reads the ledger from the reader and lists, in ID order, every automated test record whose result at the commit is not passed in a release-grade proof run, with its result or none, and every test record in another state; computed on each call. A change-grade attestation gives no result. The walk that fills Last passed at stops once every automated test record has passed somewhere, so a test record in another state can show no last pass although an older proof run within the depth passed it.

title: appbuild.Verify
description: Verify checks the executable against the trusted record.

title: appbuild.VerifySource
description: VerifySource checks a source snapshot against the record's source inventory.

title: appbuild.VerifyImage
description: VerifyImage refuses a missing record digest or signature input by name first, checks the image against its record and its trusted build record through verifyImageBuild, checks both SBOM attestations against a private copy of the manifest through checkImageSignature, and gives the verification through ImageVerifyReader.

title: appbuild.RetrieveImage
description: RetrieveImage refuses a missing signature input, missing credentials and every other input before it connects, reads the image from its explicit place in the registry into a staging folder through registryImage, checks it against its record, its trusted build record and its signature, and only then moves it to the result folder and writes registry.json with the signature; it removes the staging folder when a check fails.

title: declaration.Validate
description: Validate runs the checks that read only the declaration, with the fields that the strict reading stage found undeclared, and returns every fault in five groups (undeclared fields, service, entities, collections, slot bindings) so that the compile check reports them in a fixed order. Each fault names its rule and path. It writes no file.

title: main.currentIdentity
description: currentIdentity gives the version and the build identity that buildidentity.Current reads from the Go build metadata. Apply, the application build and the generated command line read the same shared buildidentity.Current.

title: fill.ListCatalog
description: ListCatalog builds the catalog of one slot and reads it back through fill.CatalogReader. fill.ResolveSlot first finds the slot in the active component set: it refuses an unknown slot with the slots the set declares, an ambiguous name with the components that declare it, and a component that the set does not hold. runRegistryFills (stego registry fills) prints the entries.

title: fill.ListQualification
description: ListQualification builds the qualification of each bound fill and reads it back through fill.QualificationReader. Plan and apply do not call it yet: generation does not refuse a fill that is not qualified.

title: compiler.DetectDrift
description: DetectDrift refuses while a journal is pending, reads the record, and compares every generated file and recorded input with the disk.

title: compiler.LoadPlan
description: LoadPlan reads .stego/plan.yaml through the strict decoder and writes nothing. stego plan --show prints it with FormatSavedPlan, and SavedPlan.StillApplies tells whether a plan made now from the inputs on disk gives the same saved plan.

title: compiler.Validate
description: Validate loads the declaration and the registry once, runs the registry, generator and fill checks, and puts the groups of faults from declaration.Validate between them in a fixed order. Plan and apply run the same check before they generate.

title: main.runRegistryInspect
description: runRegistryInspect answers for the component a person names, as text; with --archetype it reports every declarable input of the archetype's active component set, which compiler.ActiveComponents resolves as checking does, through registry.InputsReader, as a table or with --json as one JSON document. It refuses an archetype the registry does not hold, naming the archetypes it holds, and prints no row.

title: main.runRegistrySearch
description: runRegistrySearch keeps the components that match the -provides, -requires and -slot filters, in name order, as a table with the version, the stage and the trust of the source that supplies each.

title: registry.ListConsumers
description: ListConsumers gives every recorded service that uses one component, with the version its generation record names, from the read model the run built.

title: registry.MissedSunsets
description: MissedSunsets gives every recorded service that uses a component of the active registry past its sunset on the day the caller gives (ST-SUP-SP04), with the component, its stage and its sunset date. Every such service is reported: an acceptance in a declaration cannot reach past the sunset.
